exposure: provider asking about partner's attitude toward contraceptive methods
provider asking about women's concerns and worries regarding family planning methods
outcome: decision to use a contraceptive method after delivery
decision to use an injectable contraceptive
cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester attending a prenatal care clinic at Saint Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: Only 34.8% of women were counseled about family planning during prenatal care, but satisfaction with counseling was significantly higher when providers discussed partner attitudes and women's concerns about methods.
